name: Sumitomo Seika Chemicals Company, Limited.
summary: Sumitomo Seika Chemicals Company, Limited. engages in the manufacture and sale of absorbent polymers, functional chemicals, and gases in Japan, Asia, China, Europe, and North America. It operates through the Super Absorbent Polymers and Functional Materials segments.
